title: Log Settings
description: InstantBI logging level, file locations, retention, and activity traces

sections.title: logging
sections.description: Controls log severity, where files are written, how long daily files are kept, and optional traces for LLM, endpoint, and API activity.

fields.name: level
fields.label: Log level
fields.description: Minimum severity written to the log. DEBUG also requires App debug to be on.

fields.name: backup_days
fields.label: Backup days
fields.description: Number of daily log files to keep before older files are removed.

fields.name: file
fields.label: Log file
fields.description: Path of the rotating application log file.

fields.name: error_file
fields.label: Error log file
fields.description: Path of the rotating log file for ERROR and above.

fields.name: show_llm_activity
fields.label: Show LLM activity
fields.description: Write rendered LLM prompts and token activity to the logs.

fields.name: show_endpoint_log
fields.label: Show endpoint log
fields.description: Write HTTP endpoint request payloads to the logs.

fields.name: show_api_call_log
fields.label: Show API call log
fields.description: Write HI service API request and response payloads to the logs.

fields.name: app_debug
fields.label: App debug
fields.description: Enables debug output. Required together with Log level DEBUG for debug logs.
